name: pocket-ceo
description: A CEO in your pocket for Canadian small-business owners: an accountant that calculates exact tax and CPP for your province and builds your year-end package, a 13-week cash forecast from your bank file, invoice tracking with reminders, contract reviewer, receipt tracker, a memory that never forgets, inbox manager that writes in your voice, business consultant, video editor, daily brief, and a weekly AI coach. Type /start to set it up.
